plugins.description: Deterministic security hardening for Claude Code. Lifecycle hooks enforce container-first execution, SigmaHQ rule matching, credential-leak blocking, exfiltration and supply-chain detection, MCP data guarding, prompt-injection defense, and least-privilege subagent spawning across the full tool-use surface.
